name: Ubon Bio Ethanol Public Company Limited
summary: Ubon Bio Ethanol Public Company Limited (UBE.BK), established in 2006 and headquartered in Ubon Ratchathani, Thailand, is an integrated agro-industrial enterprise. The company's primary business involves the manufacturing and sale of processed cassava products throughout Thailand. It is a key producer of ethanol, predominantly sourced from cassava, and also engages in electricity distribution. UBE provides industrial-quality ethanol for hand sanitizer sprays under its UBON BIO and KLAR labels, and offers cassava flour and starch products through its Tasuko and Savvy brands. Beyond its processing activities, the firm also cultivates coffee and rice, and produces agricultural inputs such as organic fertilizers and various bio-substances. Its flour and starch commodities are additionally exported to international markets, including the United States and Europe.
